sentences.en: We ask all those awaiting data to please be patient.
sentences.zh: 我们请求所有等候数据的人耐心等待。

sentences.en: We are awaiting impatiently the arrival of our dear friend.
sentences.zh: 我们在急切地期待着亲爱的朋友的到来。

sentences.en: Leave your horses below and we will await you here.
sentences.zh: 把你们的马留在下面，我们会在这里等你。

senses.zh: 等候，期待，准备...以待，储存
